old_winner.label: F2_P
old_winner.rule: declared before test: the frozen leak-free finalist slot F2, i.e. the highest CV composite over all leak-pruned variants of the search; it stays the headline whatever the test numbers show

winner.label: F3_P
winner.rule: declared before test: the leak-pruned planned variant with the highest protein-disjoint CV composite on validation (the CV whose FIT records share no protein with the held-out fold, which is the test condition: test shares no protein with validation). It stays the headline whatever the test numbers show.

why: Validation-only evidence obtained after test_plan.json was written and before any test scoring: every HGB stacker loses its CV advantage when FIT records share no protein with the held-out fold (F2_P composite +0.0254 -> -0.0209). A size-matched random FIT subset (fold_sensitivity_sizematched.json) gives F2_P -0.0032, so part of the drop is the 5x smaller fit set and part (about -0.018) is partner overlap, which cannot help on test. The non-learned anchor-z exact form keeps its gain under all three fold designs. Finalists F1-F3 are unchanged and all are still scored and reported.
